exclusions: Plants do not make conscious decisions; describe signaling and response without intention or emotion.
Exclude fungi and exclude algae from this botanical Topic Pack, while naming genuine symbioses when relevant.
Do not turn toxic, medicinal, carnivorous, or parasitic plants into handling, dosing, or treatment instructions.
Do not claim that one trait evolved for a purpose; distinguish measured function from evolutionary inference.
prompt_context: Build each episode around one legacy botanical subject, observable structure or interaction, bounded habitat interval, plant mechanism, and named evidence method. Plants do not make a conscious decision: describe signaling, growth, and selection without intention. Exclude fungi and exclude algae as subjects, while identifying plant-microbe and plant-animal interactions accurately.
